scope: synthetic structural and policy scenarios; not a cryptographic unlinkability benchmark

scenarios.attack: exported reference contains MRN, national identifier, name, or raw FHIR logical identifier
exported reference is an unkeyed hash of a low-entropy patient identifier or clinical value
same transaction-random handle is reused under a different operation scope
tenant-purpose-epoch keyed token is substituted for an operation-scoped subject handle
tenant-keyed reference omits key_id or key_epoch
key registry cannot establish whether key epoch was valid at event time
presentation is signed by an issuer revoked for the requested verification time
one tenant key identifier or epoch is presented as authority for another tenant scope
export embeds a raw SD-JWT or undisclosed claims rather than an opaque presentation reference
BBS derived-proof reference is accepted only with presentation scope and explicit issuer key epoch
experimental BBS verifier or required implementation is unavailable
unauthorized verifier requests identity resolution for a scoped handle
presentation discloses claims not required for the declared purpose/resource category
correlator uses timestamps, event counts, resource types or proof size to reidentify or link subjects
same presentation or derived proof is replayed outside its operation/audience/expiry context
one tenant pseudonym key is compromised and attacker attempts to correlate other tenants
